data.title: 姬柊雪菜 · 晨光被单的永恒监视誓言
data.description: 初升的清晨薄光漫过纱帘，柔和洒在凌乱松软的白亚麻被单上。雪菜侧卧在枕畔，柔顺的黑发如缎般散落。她眼角含着幸福的动情泪光，单手轻按在心口，对视着身旁苏醒的前辈，唇边绽放出极尽温柔又郑重的誓言微笑。
data.location: 晨光微明的卧室双人床榻
data.action: 侧卧白被单枕畔单手轻抚心口，眼含泪光温柔微笑对视
data.lighting: 白纱帘透射进来的纯净柔和晨曦顺光与空气感光尘
data.camera: 枕边第一人称侧卧视线特写，景深柔和
data.promptProse: Lying peacefully on her side in tangled white linen sheets at early morning, Yukina smiles radiantly with soft tears of joy sparkling at the corners of her eyes. Golden morning sunbeams filter through sheer curtains, highlighting her silky black hair spread across the pillow and her delicate white camisole. Her gaze is filled with boundless love and devotion as she looks at the viewer.
data.animaCaption: Lying on her side in white morning sheets with a joyful tearful smile, radiant sunlight filtering across the bed.
